title.narrative: Closing the Gaps in TB Care Cascade

description.narrative: (India): ..The goal of the project is to strengthen district health systems to reduce gaps in diagnosis, treatment, and recurrence-free survival of drug-sensitive (DS-TB) and drug resistant (DR-TB) TB, in order to achieve high quality and equitable care. .. ..With FY 2022 funds, this activity will employ a variety of approaches that are needed on the spectrum of TB care. This includes identifying "missing" cases by addressing gaps in delayed care-seeking pathways, inadequate access to TB diagnostics for drug-susceptibility testing-guided treatment, and active case-finding. It will also address barriers to treatment access with decentralized access to treatment, tracking patient mobility and migration, and improved provider-patient interactions. A focus will also be on improving treatment outcomes and recurrence-free survival with improved TB counseling, enhanced care models for co-morbidities, and adherence monitoring. The activity will work on improving programmatic management of latent TB infections by targeting and monitoring high-risk groups for testing and TB preventive therapy with care cascade. Finally, interventions will be taken to health systems by developing the capacity of district leadership, health workers, and the Nikshay digital monitoring and treatment platform infrastructure to coordinate the patient care cascade and improve program performance. .. ..This intervention supports the U.S. Government's Global Tuberculosis Strategy which aims to reach every person with TB, cure those in need of treatment, and prevent the spread of disease and new infections. .
